title: Stabilize smoke test runner baseline
summary: Make repository smoke and feature test scripts run in the current Node environment with TypeScript source imports and a read-only /tmp baseline.

goal.outcome: Smoke/feature tests run through npm scripts without failing on direct TypeScript imports or read-only /tmp.
acceptance: npm test runs successfully in the current environment.
npm run test:features runs without .ts import loader failures or /tmp write failures.
Direct smoke audit command with strip-types runs without /tmp write failures.
CodeWiki health remains green after generated-state refresh.
non_goals: Do not redesign test coverage or production behavior.
Do not add a new product feature.

delta.desired: Test scripts provide the required Node type-stripping flag and tests use a writable temp root outside the repository when /tmp is unavailable.
delta.current: Smoke and feature runners failed when tests imported .ts source without strip-types and when os.tmpdir() resolved to read-only /tmp.
delta.closure: Full npm test and typecheck pass; CodeWiki health is green.
